descriptions.strlwr: Converts every upper-case letter of s to lower case in place, using the C-locale ctype table, and returns s.
descriptions.strrchr: Returns a pointer to the last occurrence of c (as signed char) in s, including the terminator, or NULL.
descriptions.w3d_round_up_digits_802efff4: Rounds a decimal digit string up at its last digit when that digit is above 4, carrying through nines; returns 0 when the carry runs out, else 1.
descriptions.strrev: Reverses the string s in place and returns s.
descriptions.itoa: Writes value in the given base to buffer (negated with a minus sign only for negative base-10 values), reverses it with strrev and returns buffer.
